List the store products the App Store, Google Play, Stripe or a payment source sells, with the
product each is mapped to and the purchases waiting for one.

--quiet prints the store product keys, which 'voidhash provider map' takes.

Usage:
  voidhash provider products [provider] [flags]

Arguments:
  provider  The provider: app-store, google-play, stripe, a payment source's slug or name, or its id

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --mapped             Only store products mapped to a product
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --refresh            Read the stores again instead of Voidhash's copy, up to an hour old
      --unmapped           Only store products not mapped to a product yet

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider products
  voidhash provider products stripe --unmapped
  voidhash provider products app-store --refresh --json
